projection_assumptions: The reference distance is the frozen editorial corridor, not the length of the instantaneous model current axis. Selected model positions and editorial vertices are retained separately.

Only neighboring original vertices with ascending reference distances may define a conditional linear reference-corridor segment, and both endpoints must pass the declared node gate. No interpolation across edge maxima, unresolved boundaries, noncorroborated/missing surface support or skipped vertices.

On an eligible segment, linear variation between endpoint lower depths or paired thicknesses is an explicit unobserved-interior assumption, not evidence of a continuous current. No extrapolation outside its reference distance interval.

Two instantaneous model snapshots, multi-day mapped surface geostrophic estimates and five-day-filtered daily mooring observations have distinct time operators. Same calendar date does not make them coincident or statistically independent.
Moorings near27S are regional fixed-station context only. They do not replace model depth values, establish collocation, fill missing model profiles or imply route continuity.

Conditional reference-corridor layer spans and lower contours do not define lateral bounds or cross-sectional area. No water volume, seasonal envelope, physical state join or full-route physical profile is admitted.
